title: A chat reveal's moment between its render and the drop effect sits outside My data's view union
evidence: From PR 1765's review (R1). The value view is one union (widget-src/src/lib/value-view-machine.ts:19-20) changed by a pure transition (:31-36), but a chat reveal is not one of its events (:22-25). Between the reveal's render and the effect that closes the page, the view is still `page`, yet shown() returns page null because revealCell !== view.seen (value-view-machine.ts:42, :45); useValuePage reads that `revealing` (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:39) and a [revealing] effect then calls drop() (useValuePage.ts:118-122), which sends close and goes back (:64-68). So for one commit the union says page while the screen shows rows, and the reveal's close is a side effect, not a transition. Remedy: a `reveal` event that moves page to rows inside transition, so the union and the screen agree in the same render; the effect keeps only the history.back() and the typed-not-saved message (:117, :120).
